title: Transport observability without secret disclosure
summary: Queue Transport exposes endpoint/listener health and counters through NoSQL projection, including endpoint identity, host, port, principal, keyId, attempts, health outcomes and listener connection/rejection counters. Raw PSK material is deliberately absent.
invariants: keyId may be projected as metadata; keyHex/raw PSK must not be projected.
Observability should expose enough identity and outcome metadata to diagnose transport health without becoming a secret store.
Source-IP rejection has a dedicated listener counter in the runtime object; future projection changes should preserve that distinction rather than folding it invisibly into generic rejection.

provenance.claim: NoSQL adapter projects endpoint/listener metadata and counters.
Endpoint row exposes keyId and health/attempt metadata but no keyHex field.
Listener runtime state includes ipRejectedCount and transport metadata.
Transport NoSQL tests pass and raw transport key is not projected.
